metadata.name: UpdateLoyaltyDisbursementParameters
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to update the disbursement parameter of an Account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789632 Condition: At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541 Condition: At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12365 Condition: At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: BSAccount ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:782154

request_fields.name: RedemptionMethod
request_fields.description: Method by which loyalty points will be redeemed for the Account. Valid Values 1 =  Manual,2 = Automatic and 3 = As per Loyalty Program Setup Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: RedemptionType
request_fields.description: Type through which the points will be applied to the Account. Valid Values : 1 = ACH,3 = Statement Credit and 5 =  Partner Pay Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: RedemptionFrequency
request_fields.description: Frequency to indicate when loyalty points will be redeemed for the Account. Valid Value: 4 = Annually on 1st cycle date 5 = Annually on 2nd cycle date 6 = Annually on 3rd cycle date 7 = Annually on 4th cycle date 8 = Annually on 5th cycle date 9 = Annually on 6th cycle date 10 = Annually on 7th cycle date 11 = Annually on 8th cycle date 12 = Annually on 8th cycle date 13 = Annually on 10th cycle date 14 = Annually on 11th cycle date 15 = Annually on 12th cycle date 16 = Monthly Specific Day 17 = Monthly Cycle Day 18 = Quarterly Specific Day 19 = Quarterly Cycle Day Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: SpecificDay
request_fields.description: Indicate the day when loyalty points will be redeemed for the Account. Example:12 (12th day) of selected frequency) Condition:This tag is required when Redemption Frequency is set to 'Monthly Specific Day' or 'Quarterly Specific Day'. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: BankAccount
request_fields.description: Account Number or Name of the bank through which redemption initiate. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654214556 Condition : BankAccountNumber can not be left blank if Redemption Type is 1 = ACH.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking Allowable Values: 15
